hook.name: NFTStrategyHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for NFT collection trading pools that takes dynamic buy fees (starting at 95% and decaying ~100 bps per 5 blocks down to 10%) and a fixed 10% sell fee. Fees are split 80% to the NFT collection contract and 20% to a configured fee address. Pool initialization and liquidity addition are restricted to the NFTStrategyFactory.
